about_the_game:
“Still Love You, Senpai” is a visual novel–style romance simulation that blends dating, club management, and META storytelling.

You play as the president of the university’s psychology research club, spending 28 days together with your live-in girlfriend, Hana. Within this limited time, you must constantly struggle between your roles as a lover and as a club president:

  • Be with your lover: Go on dates, give gifts, respond to her needs, and maintain your sweet relationship.

  • Manage the club: Plan activities, write reports, and give presentations to boost the reputation of your struggling club.

  • Work part-time: Earn money for White Day gifts and living expenses, balancing income and time.

Hana is the ideal girlfriend everyone envies. She cares for you, supports you, teases you playfully at times, yet always lends a hand when you’re exhausted. But as the calendar pages turn, you begin to sense something unsettling…

Love and responsibility. Money and time.
When everything spirals out of control, you’ll discover—this was never just your choice.

Game Features

  • Sweet yet anxious 28-day schedule management: balance part-time work, romance, and club activities.

  • Girlfriend interactions: dates / gifts / Live2D scenes / CG collection.

  • Club mini-games: TRPGs, reports, and random events that affect reputation.

  • Multiple endings: from ordinary romance to disturbing truths, waiting to be uncovered.

  • A unique blend of META narrative and psychological suspense.

Characters

Hana Hana (CV: Haruka Amachi) — your junior and live-in girlfriend.

Her eyes are always on you, putting your feelings first. She accompanies, supports, and encourages you, becoming the warmest presence in your life.
Her occasional playful tsundere side makes her even more endearing, but most of the time, she’s attentive and caring. When you push yourself with part-time jobs, she won’t hesitate to offer financial support, just to walk by your side.

In her smile, you’ll see the image of the “perfect girlfriend.”

If you enjoyed games like Doki Doki Literature Club, Needy Streamer Overload, or Milky Way Prince, this title will bring you an experience both familiar and unexpectedly strange!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mild nudity in certain story CGs, such as depictions of characters in underwear or partially clothed.
